data.name: Qamarun
data.gender_notes: Qamarun is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Qamarun is an Arabic name that symbolizes the beauty and tranquility of the moon. It is a name that evokes feelings of calmness and serenity. The name Qamarun carries the meaning “Moon” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Qamarun usually hope their child will grow to embody moon and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.etymology: Qamarun belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Moon.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Qamarun total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.
